title: What If a 1 km Asteroid Hit Your City?

lines.text: A one-kilometer asteroid is about to hit your city.
It's falling at twenty kilometers every second.
The air in front of it gets so hot, it glows brighter than the sun.
In an instant, it releases the energy of millions of Hiroshima bombs.
A fireball over twenty kilometers wide swallows downtown.
The shockwave flattens buildings far beyond the city.
Where downtown stood, there's now a crater fifteen kilometers wide.
Rock blasted high into the sky comes raining back down, on fire.
And the dust could dim the sun for the whole planet.
The good news? NASA has found most asteroids this big, and none are headed our way.
In 2022, we even crashed a spacecraft into an asteroid, and changed its orbit.
But if one ever slipped through...
